WHEELED  MOBILE  ROBOTS   
Wheeled  mobile  robots  (WMRs)  are  robots  that  use  wheels  for  movement.  They  are  widely  used  in  various  applications  due  to  their  simplicity  and  efficiency  in  navigation  and  control.  Here’s  an  overview  of  the  key  aspects  of  wheeled  mobile  robots:   TYPES  OF  WHEELED  MOBILE  ROBOTS   Differential  Drive  Robots:

D  MOBILE  ROBOTS   Differential  Drive  Robots:  These  robots  have  two  wheels  that  can  be  independently  driven.  They  are  simple  to  design  and  control.   Tricycle  Robots:  These  robots  typically  have  one  driving  wheel  and  two  passive  wheels  for  balance.  They  are  similar  to  bicycles  in  their  movement.   Omnidirectional  Robots:  These  robots  use  specially  designed  wheels,  like  omni  wheels  or  mecanum  wheels,  to  move  in  any  direction  without  ch

wheels,  to  move  in  any  direction  without  changing
